The <b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a <i>[[Game of Crone]]s</i>-specific construct, located in the [[refugee camp]], just north of the garden. It crafts autonomously, presumably operated by the refugees - if not the [[cook]], as her presence isn't required in order to construct it or be operated. The required materials need to be stored in the [[storehouse]], and while the player cannot choose specifically which recipes are made, the recipes do not need to first be unlocked through [[Cookery (Tech Tree)|Cookery]].
